meta.name: agenthub
meta.description: Multi-agent collaboration plugin that spawns N parallel subagents competing on the same task via git worktree isolation. Agents work independently, results are evaluated by metric or LLM judge, and the best branch is merged. Use when: user wants multiple approaches tried in parallel — code optimization, content variation, research exploration, or any task that benefits from parallel competition. Requires: a git repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行运行多个子代理竞争同一任务，自动合并最优结果
copy.tagline_en: Run multiple subagents in parallel on the same task and auto-merge the best result
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want multiple approaches tried in parallel and the best one automatically merged

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成多智能体协作的协调者。它能同时启动多个独立子智能体，让它们用不同方法完成同一任务，然后自动评估结果并合并最优方案。
howto.when: 当你提到“尝试多种方法”、“让智能体竞争”、“并行优化”等关键词，或要求生成多个版本、对比不同方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我写三个不同版本的广告文案，让它们竞争，选最好的。
用多种方法优化这段代码的性能，让智能体比赛。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a coordinator for multi-agent collaboration. It can spawn multiple independent sub-agents to work on the same task using different approaches, evaluate their results, and merge the best one.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention phrases like "try multiple approaches", "have agents compete", "parallel optimization", or ask for multiple versions or comparison of different solutions.

say_en.text: Write three different versions of ad copy, have them compete, and pick the best.
Optimize this code's performance using multiple methods, let the agents compete.
